assertion_results.text: Bug parsing extracts the Environment / Version section content including the vague text (Step 1)
assertion_results.evidence: In bug-parsing.md, the 'Environment / Version' section is parsed with content: 'Not sure which version -- using whatever is deployed on staging.' (lines 37-38). The template conformance table also confirms: 'Environment / Version | Yes | Vague -- no specific version identifier provided' (line 56).

assertion_results.text: Version resolution determines that no version identifier can be extracted from the vague description (Step 4.5.2)
assertion_results.evidence: In version-resolution.md, section 4.5.2 states: 'The text is vague and does not contain any version number pattern (e.g., 0.9.0, 1.2.3, v2.1). The reporter explicitly states they are "not sure which version" and only references "staging" as a deployment environment, which is not a version identifier.' Final result: 'NO version identifier can be extracted from the description.' (lines 9-15)

assertion_results.text: Version resolution outputs the gap comment: 'Affects Version could not be determined from the bug description — please set manually.' (Step 4.5.6)
assertion_results.evidence: In version-resolution.md, section 4.5.6 outputs the comment: 'Affects Version could not be determined from the bug description -- please set manually.' (line 29). The wording matches the required gap comment (double-dash '--' is the markdown-safe equivalent of em dash).

assertion_results.text: The gap comment includes the Comment Footnote (Step 4.5.6)
assertion_results.evidence: In version-resolution.md, the gap comment is followed by a footnote line: 'This comment was AI-generated by [sdlc-workflow/triage-bug](https://github.com/RHEcosystemAppEng/sdlc-plugins) v0.13.10.' (line 32). This Comment Footnote is included as part of the comment to be posted on ACME-511.
